provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Dwellings of Eldervale Rules of Play (2024)

steps.text: Score Board at one end of the table
Each player picks a faction tray (or deal Starter cards); choose a board side as your Ready Area
Everyone rolls 6 dice; highest is Starting Player, then clockwise
Scoring markers on the Victory Point track at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in turn order
Elements this game: the players' elements plus 2 more
For each element: Doorway card faceup on its Adventure deck, then shuffle the rest below it
Check each Treasure stack has 3 tokens of its element
Set aside the 5 main Ruins{n}
Oracle: swap it in for an Elemental tile (2-3 players) or the second Dungeon (4-5 players)
Shuffle the Elemental Realms into the Realm Stack
Draw {n} Elemental Realms (max 1 Lair; extra Lairs go to the bottom of the stack)
Shuffle them with the Ruins and arrange faceup in the layout for your player count, same orientation
Reshuffle the Realm Stack facedown in the Discard Tray
Dragon's Den: add it to the top half of the Realm Stack
Bifrost Bridge: mix it into the top half of the Realm Stack
Treasure stacks (top faceup) on the Realm treasure spaces; Monster on each Lair
An Orb on top of each element track in use; 1 Orb on each of the 2 Glory Track spaces
2 Resource Trays with resources split evenly; Discard Tray in the middle
Shuffle the Magic cards into the Resource Tray; each player draws 5
3 Workers in your Ready Area; Dragon, Wizard, Warrior, 3 Workers, 6 Dwellings, 1 each of Gem/Potion/Scroll/Tool/Sword and 6 dice in your tray
Your Element Starter card next to your tray as your first Tableau card
1 scoring marker on your element's first Power space; 1 kept for the Glory Track; 3 beside the Power tracks
Mercenary cards and figures within reach
Starting Player begins; play continues clockwise
